resolution: The journal dump the user pasted pinned the Add-refusal exactly. Their model (primitive:cube:34, heavy loop-cut/extrude/symmetrize/merge history, ONE part) is NEVER-PAINTED — no atlas raster or layout resident (atlas creation is the explicit Paint-entry choice; journal state bytes confirm no raster). appendGroupInner unconditionally demanded reserveNeutralPlaceholderUv() for any non-empty mesh, which returns null with no atlas — so EVERY Add Part on an edited unpainted model failed with only a terminal std.log line. Fixed host-side (77f5cee27, rebuild required): with no atlas there is nothing to preserve — the append takes the plain install, re-asserts captured face colours via the atlas-independent applyExactFaceColors, and grows the part-range table from a PRE-replace capture (the plain replace resets the table; a post-replace read would have shrunk the partition to the new pair alone). Hidden-part stashes without an atlas still fail closed. The partition guard itself was NOT the tripwire — it tolerates the merge-faces group-id holes in their dump. Also landed 8b818b56a: build.zig follow-up completing a parallel session's v8_*.zig root move that my commit swept via the shared index, so HEAD builds. Open observations for the same doc: the current journal note carries a stale React mirror (hi:6 vs host hi:60), and the black bars are likely merge-faces colour rows lost on an unpainted model — both need the model saved or a live look next session.
